purpose: Screen the fast patch/variable-scan MambaTS v4 backbone with train-only ACF forecast memory and ACF-to-AutoCon representation fusion on the same H96 coordinates as the completed six-baseline matrix.
research_question: Can a MambaTS-inspired per-variable patch head retain its current resource advantage over PatchTST while train-only ACF memory and a low-weight AutoCon representation objective improve the high-dimensional validation signal without hiding the lambda-null control?
evidence_boundary: Exploratory validation-only H96 screen. Test metrics remain withheld. Three seeds and eight epochs are a candidate gate, not publication, non-inferiority, or speed evidence.
claim_boundary: Do not claim universal accuracy, AutoCon causal gain, speed, or publication readiness. The lambda=0 arm retains the same MambaTSv4 ACF/representation architecture and is the only relation-objective null.

required_before_launch: verify four data hashes and the source snapshot
verify all arms use M features, MeanStd, H96, and skip_test=true
review that lambda=0 is the AutoCon objective null rather than a plain Mamba control
keep the matched resource protocol separate from training wall-time interpretation

phases.name: mambatsv3_plain_h96
phases.purpose: Plain fast MambaTS v3 forecasting control with no ACF memory or AutoCon projection.

phases.name: mambatsv4_acf_autocon_null_h96
phases.purpose: MambaTS v4 with train-only ACF forecast memory and ACF representation fusion; AutoCon objective null control.

phases.name: mambatsv4_acf_autocon_lambda001_h96
phases.purpose: Exact MambaTS v4 ACF/representation match with a low-weight active AutoCon objective.

primary_contrasts: MambaTSv4 AutoCon lambda=0.001 versus exact MambaTSv4 AutoCon lambda=0 null
MambaTSv4 AutoCon lambda=0.001 versus plain MambaTSv3
MambaTSv4 AutoCon lambda=0.001 versus completed same-coordinate external baselines
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: A favorable result only gates a future multi-horizon, full-budget confirmation and resource protocol. It cannot be a paper accuracy, non-inferiority, or speed claim.

resource_contract.existing_gate: MambaTSv3/MambaTSv3AutoCon was separately benchmarked against PatchTST and Mamba2 with device-resident forwards; the selected v4 candidate needs the same prediction and train-step protocol before an efficiency claim.
resource_contract.training_wall_time: Manifest elapsed seconds are descriptive and cannot establish speed.
